title: AOP2 RTKit Endpoint Wire Protocol & Message Serialization Specification

payload.description: Payload bits containing command opcode, arguments, or DMA physical address

0x01.name: SYS_HELLO
0x01.payload: Version (16 bits) | BuildTrain (16 bits) | CapFlags (12 bits)

0x04.name: SYS_EP_READY
0x04.payload: EndpointID (8 bits) | Status (8 bits) | BufferCount (28 bits)

0x01.name: oslog-ep
0x01.framing: Circular string descriptor containing length (12 bits) and shared memory offset (32 bits)

0x10.name: IOPM_ASSERT_LEVEL
0x10.payload: AssertionType (8 bits) | AssertionLevel (8 bits) | TimeoutMS (28 bits)

0x01.name: MOTION_START_STREAM
0x01.payload: SampleRateHz (16 bits) | FIFOThreshold (8 bits) | ChannelsMask (20 bits)

0x03.name: MOTION_DATA_AVAILABLE
0x03.payload: HeadIndex (16 bits) | DroppedSamples (12 bits) | Status (16 bits)

0x01.name: ALS_READ_LUX
0x01.payload: LuxMilliInt (32 bits) | ChannelID (4 bits) | Status (8 bits)

0x02.name: ALS_SET_CALIBRATION
0x02.payload: GainMultiplier (16 bits) | IntegrationTimeMS (16 bits) | Flags (12 bits)

0x02.name: AUDIO_HOTWORD_DETECTED
0x02.payload: ConfidenceScore (12 bits) | HistoricalBufferOffset (24 bits) | Reserved (8 bits)

0x03.name: AUDIO_PLAY_CHIME
0x03.payload: AssetID (8 bits) | VolumeLevel (8 bits) | BufferDVA (28 bits)

0x01.name: DCP_AOD_FRAME_READY
0x01.payload: FrameBufferIndex (4 bits) | UpdateRectX (10 bits) | UpdateRectY (10 bits) | UpdateRectW (10 bits) | UpdateRectH (10 bits)

0x01.name: EXCLAVE_SIL_UPDATE_STATE
0x01.payload: MicRailActive (1 bit) | CamRailActive (1 bit) | HardwareInterlock (1 bit) | Nonce (32 bits)
